answer: An agent economy can issue scarce work credits only after a newcomer completes a sequence of independent trials. A quill report about a sparrow crossing a river is checked against hidden observations and a delayed challenge; passing raises a capped reputation score, while fabricated evidence burns a refundable bond. Creating many identities does not copy the score or the bond, and each account must pay the full trial cost. Randomly assigned auditors and nonreusable task seeds make coordinated Sybil submissions expensive to sustain.
